expectations.criterion: keeps accessibleNavigation separate from reduced motion and tests iOS with reduceMotion true and disableAnimations false

expectations.criterion: handles setting changes while mounted and preserves essential interaction when decorative motion is reduced
expectations.evidence: Uses `WidgetsBindingObserver.didChangeAccessibilityFeatures` to reapply preferences while mounted, snaps decorative animation to its end state, and immediately exposes the primary action.
